newsitem.title: UK: Unigate sells rest of U.S. restaurant unit.
newsitem.headline: Unigate sells rest of U.S. restaurant unit.

text.p: UK-based food and distribution group Unigate Plc said on Wednesday it was to sell the rest of its U.S. Casa Bonita restaurant business to CKE Restaurants for $42 million in cash.
Proceeds from the sale will form part of the funds available for investment in the group's food and distribution business.

"The sale of Casa Bonita marks our exit from the U.S. and leaves the group totally focused on its core businesses of European food and distribution," said Unigate chief executive Ross Buckland in a statement.
Unigate sold its Black-eyed Pea Restaurants in July.
Operating profit at Casa Bonita for the year to March 1996 was $4.6 million and net assets at the date of sale were $26.4 million. The sale was subject to U.S. regulatory approval.
